questions.question: How do you get to Thoraxis?
questions.explanation: Right-click a Red Ant. Sacrifice one in a Nyxite frame and you get a portal.

questions.question: Where do Red Ants nest?
questions.explanation: The Nether. And they bite, so watch out.

questions.question: What does Antiwater do?
questions.explanation: It flows up instead of down. It makes geysers too.

questions.question: What is Bluestone?
questions.explanation: Basically Redstone but upside down. You can even make upside down rails with it.

questions.question: How do Dimensional Tears work?
questions.explanation: They come in pairs. Walk into one and you pop out of the other one.

questions.question: How do you reach the Underside?
questions.explanation: Fall through a gravity throat. You come out the bottom upside down.

questions.question: When does the Nightmare hit hardest?
questions.explanation: When you're low on health. So heal up before you fight it.

questions.question: What does the Queen add in her final phase?
questions.explanation: Her own time dilation field. Anyone caught in it slows right down.
